'''Homefront II''' is the 9th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on 6 August 2011. The set consists of 54 cards. This set is part of the ''Core Block'' consisting of cards from [[Homefront]], [[Homefront II]], [[Homefront III]], [[Homefront IV]], [[Homefront V]], and [[Homefront VI]].
